scripts.dev: npm run build -w @pic/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,blue,green "tsc -b shared --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w @pic/server" "npm run dev -w @pic/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pic/shared && npm run build -w @pic/server && npm run build -w @pic/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pic/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pic/server && npm run typecheck -w @pic/client
